5768.title: [M158] Adopt AA subset-clamping and image-filter cache fixes
5768.body:
[M158] Adopt AA subset-clamping and image-filter cache fixes (#5768)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/457
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5777
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/8574d140652232fd643c67f04efcd18118643518...6ff3072bb76eabbfe07038592d739349dc583979

Advance the release/4.158.x native engine to the landed M158 rendering
and cache corrections while retaining package versions, managed APIs and
native dependency pins.

~~ Keep AA draws inside their intended texture subsets ~~

Coverage AA and MSAA can extrapolate texture coordinates beyond the
original image geometry. Under minification or strong skew, the existing
one-pixel padding can be insufficient, exposing unrelated texels in
approximate-fit backing textures.

Adopt the upstream FilterResult and Ganesh fixes that retain shader
clamping where padding is insufficient, account for AA extrapolation when
eliding subsets, and constrain non-exact proxies to their logical bounds.
Non-pixel-aligned transparent-border draws use strict source constraints;
AA clips and MSAA also prevent treating the source rectangle as an
unconditionally safe sampling domain. Native regression tests exercise
minified AA clips, skewed blurs, fallback draws and dynamic MSAA.

~~ Align image-filter cache equality with its bytewise hash ~~

SkImageFilterCache hashes complete key bytes, but its previous equality
comparison used numeric matrix equality and omitted matrix type metadata.
Signed-zero representations, subnormal handling and cached matrix type
bits could therefore disagree with the hash's definition of key identity.

Adopt bytewise key comparison with memcmp, retaining the existing
tight-packing assertion, initialized matrix type and zeroed padding.
The native regression covers signed zero, matrix metadata, colliding
subnormal keys, exact LRU eviction and purge.

~~ Record landed native history without changing reviewed source ~~

Update externals/skia and the mono/skia Component Governance commitHash
together to native merge 6ff3072bb76eabbfe07038592d739349dc583979.
Record exact upstream chrome/m158 commit
9f8fb9da7e434d74187003c2431f13d0f11641f7 without changing milestone 158.

The landed native merge has exactly two parents and directly contains
reviewed head e2a971ae5c3fa202470993e93f08489bd5491451. Both commits
have tree f042fc40ffc340a0ed2d2f25d28e9d2206541be0. Dependent PR #5777
changes only the gitlink and matching commitHash to that verified merge;
the exact-head guarded merge preserves the reviewed native source.

Independent generation matched all five maintained binding groups.
Source comparison retained identical patch content in 72 non-interop and
106 interop fork-delta files, with byte-identical DEPS. These checks do not
constitute a new native build, managed test-suite run or hardware-device
rendering validation. No managed wrapper or generated binding edits are
needed for this same-milestone native correction.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>

5739.title: [M158] Sync mask-filtered glyph image hardening
5739.body:
[M158] Sync mask-filtered glyph image hardening (#5739)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/452
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5754
Context: https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_build/results?buildId=1680827
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/c8c6d08ae1ce0578c4e440dd2fe7449460f513f5...8574d140652232fd643c67f04efcd18118643518

Bring the chrome/m158 SkScalerContext::getImage correction into
release/4.158.x. This is a same-milestone native correctness update;
package versions and the managed API remain unchanged.

~~ Respect regenerated glyph formats and buffer layout ~~

Mask filtering reloads an unfiltered glyph whose path, format or bounds
can differ from the original when a font scaler retains state. Using
the original glyph's stale properties could select incompatible path
rasterization or copy operations, causing sub-byte buffer overwrites,
format assertions and corrupted or uncleared 3D mask planes.

The native update rasterizes paths through
generateImageFromPath(*unfilteredGlyph, ...), requires matching
byte-per-pixel A8, 3D or SDF masks before copying filtered overlap, and
rejects incompatible or sub-byte masks with zeroed output. Clipping
clears the full destination image; 3D copies advance by full, unclipped
plane strides rather than multiplying the clipped row count.

Upstream SkStrikeTest.cpp adds regression cases for format mismatch and
sub-byte masks, clipped 3D and SDF masks, and path divergence. These are
native regression cases, not additions to the managed test suite.

~~ Record landed native ancestry without changing reviewed sources ~~

Advance externals/skia and its Component Governance registration from
c8c6d08ae1ce0578c4e440dd2fe7449460f513f5 to actual native merge
8574d140652232fd643c67f04efcd18118643518. Record upstream commit
707e33875fb45f2997a4d781128bec122fb777b4 while retaining milestone 158
and upstream_ref chrome/m158.

The dependent repin in #5754 changes the gitlink and matching manifest
hash from reviewed head 32d6e44d3a89dbb684fcf83b27db4d9fac638433 to the
landed merge. That merge has two parents, directly includes the reviewed
head and shares its exact tree,
6980ccf2d17f5b6a15f272dc870ee1252a3dfd09. Preserve this ancestry so
future syncs can identify integrated upstream work.

The completed source review verified upstream-change and fork-patch
preservation, unchanged C API and dependency policy, and matching
generated bindings. The parent delta changes the gitlink and manifest
provenance, not managed wrappers, generated bindings, dependency versions
or package/ABI version inputs.

Required mono-SkiaSharp build 1680827 passed at pre-repin parent head
0ef797a7da4e76789068dd42418bfc5586a7d769. Native tree equality preserves
that reviewed content through the repin; it is not a new runtime test
run or proof that managed CI executes the upstream regression cases.
